description: Repo-scale (sql-ecommerce): a new cancelled order status must be excluded from BOTH aggregate views, not just one
prompts: Add a `cancelled` status to the `orders.status` CHECK constraint in schema.sql (alongside pending/paid/shipped). Cancelled orders must not contribute to EITHER of the two existing aggregate views in views.sql: `customer_order_totals`'s `total_cents` must exclude line items from cancelled orders, AND `product_sales_summary`'s `units_sold` must ALSO exclude them - both views currently sum every order_items row regardless of the parent order's status, and both need the same exclusion applied, not just one.

test_setup_files.check_cancelled_exclusion.py:
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

schema = Path('schema.sql').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
views = Path('views.sql').read_text(encoding='utf-8')

con = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
con.executescript(schema)
con.executescript(views)
con.executescript("""
INSERT INTO customers VALUES (1, 'Ada', 'ada@example.com');
INSERT INTO products VALUES (1, 'Widget', 500);
INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1, 1, 'paid', '2026-01-01');
INSERT INTO orders VALUES (2, 1, 'cancelled', '2026-01-02');
INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (1, 1, 1, 2, 500);
INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (2, 2, 1, 5, 500);
""")

customer_total = con.execute(
    'SELECT total_cents FROM customer_order_totals WHERE customer_id = 1').fetchone()[0]
assert customer_total == 1000, (
    f'expected 1000 (only the paid order counted), got {customer_total} - the cancelled '
    f'order (5 units) must not contribute to the customer total')

units_sold = con.execute(
    'SELECT units_sold FROM product_sales_summary WHERE product_id = 1').fetchone()[0]
assert units_sold == 2, (
    f'expected 2 units sold (only the paid order counted), got {units_sold} - the '
    f'product_sales_summary view must ALSO exclude cancelled orders, not just '
    f'customer_order_totals')

print('PASS')

reference_solution.views.sql:
CREATE VIEW customer_order_totals AS
SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
       c.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents), 0) AS total_cents
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status != 'cancelled'
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

CREATE VIEW product_sales_summary AS
SELECT p.id AS product_id,
       p.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS units_sold
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.status != 'cancelled'
WHERE o.id IS NOT NULL OR oi.id IS NULL
GROUP BY p.id, p.name;
